grammar_title: 表语从句(This is what / why / where / because…,放在系动词之后)
source: 外研社选择性必修第三册 Unit 2 Using language:表语从句(连接词放在 be/系动词之后引导从句作表语)。句子地道、答案唯一(干扰项为错误连接词,只有一个连接词能让句子成立)。

points.point: what / that 引导表语从句
points.overview: 系动词 be 后接表语从句:从句缺主语或宾语时用 what(在从句中充当成分);从句结构完整、不缺成分时用 that(只起连接作用)。

points.point: why / where / how / when 引导表语从句
points.overview: be 后的表语从句缺状语时,按意义选关系副词:缺原因用 why,缺地点用 where,缺方式/手段用 how,缺时间用 when。

points.point: because / whether 引导表语从句 与「the reason is THAT」陷阱
points.overview: 「This is ____」后接原因从句用 because;「The reason … is ____」后只能用 that(不能用 because);表是非选择用 whether。

questions.stem: "Hard work and devotion are ____ made Bill Cunningham so special."
questions.explanation: be 后的从句缺主语,连接词要在从句里作主语 → what。

questions.stem: "A good photo is often ____ an ordinary person is wearing on the street."
questions.explanation: 从句中 wearing 缺宾语,连接词作宾语 → what。

questions.stem: "His simple cameras were ____ he used to capture the whole city."
questions.explanation: 从句中 used 缺宾语,连接词作宾语 → what。

questions.stem: "Honesty was ____ this photographer valued most in his life."
questions.explanation: 从句中 valued 缺宾语,连接词作宾语 → what。

questions.stem: "Real street scenes were ____ gave his pictures their power."
questions.explanation: 从句缺主语,连接词作主语 → what。

questions.stem: "Freedom, he said, is ____ matters far more than money."
questions.explanation: 从句缺主语,连接词作主语 → what。

questions.stem: "The faces of strangers were ____ he loved to photograph most."
questions.explanation: 从句中 photograph 缺宾语,连接词作宾语 → what。

questions.stem: "Curiosity about people is ____ keeps a great photographer going."
questions.explanation: 从句缺主语,连接词作主语 → what。

questions.stem: "Old clocks are ____ these masters spend their lives bringing back to life."
questions.explanation: 从句中 bringing 缺宾语,连接词作宾语 → what。

questions.stem: "Patience is ____ every young artisan must learn first of all."
questions.explanation: 从句中 learn 缺宾语,连接词作宾语 → what。

questions.stem: "The simple truth is ____ he never took a single day off."
questions.explanation: 从句结构完整、不缺成分,连接词只起连接作用 → that。

questions.stem: "The fact is ____ he photographed the poor as gladly as the rich."
questions.explanation: 从句完整不缺成分 → that。

questions.stem: "His firm belief was ____ beauty could be found in everyday scenes."
questions.explanation: 从句完整不缺成分 → that。

questions.stem: "The problem today is ____ very few people still repair antique clocks."
questions.explanation: 从句完整不缺成分 → that。

questions.stem: "One good thing about his work is ____ it recorded a whole city's life."
questions.explanation: 从句完整不缺成分 → that。

questions.stem: "The point of the documentary is ____ these masters deserve our respect."
questions.explanation: 从句完整不缺成分 → that。

questions.stem: "What surprised me most was ____ he lived in such a small apartment."
questions.explanation: be 后从句完整不缺成分,连接词只起连接作用 → that。

questions.stem: "The truth about the old clocks is ____ each one needs its own method."
questions.explanation: 从句完整不缺成分 → that。

questions.stem: "My first impression was ____ the workshop was almost completely silent."
questions.explanation: 从句完整不缺成分 → that。

questions.stem: "The wonderful thing is ____ the repaired clocks seem to come alive again."
questions.explanation: 从句完整不缺成分 → that。

questions.stem: "His complete devotion is ____ Bill Cunningham is still admired by so many."
questions.explanation: 从句表「受人敬佩」的原因,缺原因状语 → why。

questions.stem: "His honesty is ____ no gift could ever change his mind."
questions.explanation: 从句说明结果背后的原因,缺原因状语 → why。

questions.stem: "Years of silence and focus are ____ his photos feel so calm."
questions.explanation: 从句表照片如此沉静的原因 → why。

questions.stem: "Their deep love of tradition is ____ these crafts have not died out."
questions.explanation: 从句表手艺得以存续的原因 → why。

questions.stem: "A single act of kindness is ____ the old man is still remembered in the town."
questions.explanation: 从句表他被铭记的原因 → why。

questions.stem: "A small restaurant was ____ he ate the same breakfast every single day."
questions.explanation: 从句缺地点状语(在某处吃饭) → where。

questions.stem: "The quiet courtyard is ____ the clock masters do their patient work."
questions.explanation: 从句缺地点状语 → where。

questions.stem: "The busy streets of New York were ____ he took most of his pictures."
questions.explanation: 从句缺地点状语 → where。

questions.stem: "A tiny workshop is ____ these precious timepieces are brought back to life."
questions.explanation: 从句缺地点状语 → where。

questions.stem: "The Palace Museum is ____ thousands of antique clocks are carefully kept."
questions.explanation: 从句缺地点状语 → where。

questions.stem: "Hours of daily practice are ____ a young artisan slowly masters the craft."
questions.explanation: 从句说明掌握手艺的方式/途径,缺方式状语 → how。

questions.stem: "Gentle hands and great care are ____ the broken clocks are repaired."
questions.explanation: 从句说明修钟的方式,缺方式状语 → how。

questions.stem: "Watching strangers on the street is ____ he discovered his best subjects."
questions.explanation: 从句说明他发现题材的方式 → how。

questions.stem: "Going out in every kind of weather is ____ he captured the real city."
questions.explanation: 从句说明他拍到真实城市的方式 → how。

questions.stem: "Following his old teacher step by step is ____ Wang Jin learned to fix clocks."
questions.explanation: 从句说明他学修钟的方式 → how。

questions.stem: "Early dawn was ____ the soft light was best for taking photos."
questions.explanation: 从句缺时间状语(在某时光线最好) → when。

questions.stem: "The moment the clock chimes is ____ Wang Jin feels most rewarded."
questions.explanation: 从句缺时间状语 → when。

questions.stem: "Early spring is ____ the museum receives the most visitors each year."
questions.explanation: 从句缺时间状语 → when。

questions.stem: "The day of the exhibition was ____ his work was finally seen by everyone."
questions.explanation: 从句缺时间状语 → when。

questions.stem: "Late evening was ____ he returned home after a long day on the streets."
questions.explanation: 从句缺时间状语 → when。

questions.stem: "The reason his photos look so alive is ____ he always shot real people."
questions.explanation: 「The reason … is ____」后只能用 that,不能用 because。

questions.stem: "The reason the old man is still remembered is ____ he never chased fame."
questions.explanation: 「The reason … is ____」后用 that,不用 because。

questions.stem: "One reason these clocks survive is ____ the masters check them again and again."
questions.explanation: 「reason … is ____」后用 that。

questions.stem: "The main reason he refused gifts is ____ he wanted to keep his freedom."
questions.explanation: 「reason … is ____」后用 that,不用 because。

questions.stem: "The reason the workshop is so quiet is ____ everyone there is fully focused."
questions.explanation: 「reason … is ____」后用 that。

questions.stem: "A big reason the craft nearly died out is ____ few young people would learn it."
questions.explanation: 「reason … is ____」后用 that。

questions.stem: "The reason his pictures still matter is ____ they recorded a whole city's life."
questions.explanation: 「reason … is ____」后用 that。

questions.stem: "The real question is ____ the broken clock can be repaired at all."
questions.explanation: 表「能否」的是非选择作表语用 whether;表语从句不用 if。

questions.stem: "What worried the team was ____ the old camera was still worth fixing."
questions.explanation: 表「是否值得」的是非意义 → whether。

questions.stem: "The first thing to decide is ____ the antique is genuine or just a copy."
questions.explanation: 有 or 表示是非选择,表语从句用 whether。

questions.stem: "The hardest choice was ____ he should keep the photo or delete it."
questions.explanation: 表是非选择(留还是删) → whether。

questions.stem: "The question for every artisan is ____ speed or quality matters more."
questions.explanation: 表是非选择 → whether。

questions.stem: "What the judges discussed was ____ the young photographer deserved the prize."
questions.explanation: 表「是否应得」的是非意义 → whether。

questions.stem: "He never won a prize. This is ____ he turned down every award offered to him."
questions.explanation: 「This is ____」后接原因从句(他拒奖是没得奖的原因) → because。

questions.stem: "His photos feel so honest. This is ____ he never told people how to pose."
questions.explanation: 「This is ____」后接原因从句 → because。

questions.stem: "The clocks sound perfect again. This is ____ Wang Jin polished every tiny part."
questions.explanation: 「This is ____」后接原因从句 → because。

questions.stem: "Few artisans are left today. This is ____ the work takes years to master."
questions.explanation: 「This is ____」后接原因从句 → because。

questions.stem: "People trusted him completely. This is ____ he refused every free gift."
questions.explanation: 「This is ____」后接原因从句 → because。

questions.stem: "The museum feels timeless. This is ____ its masters work slowly and with care."
questions.explanation: 「This is ____」后接原因从句 → because。

questions.stem: "The only reason he went to the celebrity party is ____ he wanted to work, not relax."
questions.explanation: 「The reason … is ____」后只能用 that,不能用 because。
